Ships changed a great deal in the nineteenth century.
Steam replaced sail on most routes.
Ports grew quickly as trade expanded.

Water use in India has risen sharply.
Droughts are becoming more frequent.
Many rivers now run dry in summer.

Forest soils hold a great deal of carbon.
Tree roots reach surprisingly deep.
Fungi link the roots of many trees.

The Cold War shaped European politics for decades.
Spies operated in every major capital.
Berlin was divided by a wall.

Spanish painting flourished in the seventeenth century.
Velázquez worked for the royal court.
Goya came more than a century later.

Sleep is essential for good health.
Dreams occur mostly during REM sleep.
Insomnia affects millions of adults.

Coastal birds depend on healthy wetlands.
Gulls have adapted well to cities.
Terns migrate enormous distances.

Parasites are found in nearly every ecosystem.
Microbes outnumber all other living things.
Germs spread easily in crowded places.
